notes.title: Party Words is going Free to Play!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/c69f3747f1d1977b7c4fc08510cc1c6cbd59def3.png[/img]
Hey Party People!

First off, big thanks to everyone who has supported our projects!

Since Party Words is a multiplayer-only game we've decided to offer it for free to everyone to make it easier to play with your friends regardless of what platform they're using :) We've removed the ads from the mobile version so it's Free to Play for them too.

We've also made some updates to help make the game easier to understand for new (or returning) players! All the rules have been revamped, joined players see better directions on the Room screen, and everyone gets a short description of the game mode before each round.

The other big change you may notice is that now Categories is available as a standard deck so you can play your own version of Pyramid! Hopefully your friends do better than Joey ;P

[previewyoutube=28LNdwfhW6I;thumb][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for playing our games!
- Kelsam
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/9773d37b7afb94f06cacd5ceeb86ab55812ae91e.png[/img]

notes.title: Need something fun to do with your family over the holidays?
notes.content:
[h3]Just in time to spice up your festivities![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/e1eb38429f45148d71ae9e0373cf4c181c35ba11.png[/img]
We made it! Version 1.0 is here :D 

[h3]Don't want to pass the game around?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/8ec9563ba0008e1f65c9ececfd86fcc530f26404.png[/img]
Party Words is cross-platform and now available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992530/Party_Words/]Steam[/url] (PC), [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.kelsam.partywords]Google Play[/url] (Android), and [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/party-words-mobile/id1644569599]App Store[/url] (iOS)—so your friends and cousins can join and play on their own devices!

[h3]Save the memories[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/70a7efd03fffc77ee1dd1a1ae35426c980bdd6af.jpg[/img]
We've added a few more colors to Doodle It modes and Doodles can now be downloaded and shared with the click of a button.

notes.title: v0.52 Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added more pen colors for Doodle It mode
[*]Fixed issue with Doodle It mode dealing out repeat cards before they've all been used
[*]Updated per-player score screen (currently only seen in Doodle It mode) to sort by player number instead of score
[*]Fixed Doodle It Guess Phase not having chime and skip sounds on button presses
[*]Fixed issue with previous host sometimes still getting host buttons in future games
[*]Fixed some card typos
[*]Updated verbiage around starting games to reduce confusion between multi-device and single-device gameplay and to provide a basic description of how the game is meant to be played
[/list]

notes.title: Party Words is available on Steam! Here's What You Need to Know:
notes.content:
Hey Party People!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992530/Party_Words/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/2fc2047be697a8fd7ad44ca040b1f40d7899fe68.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Party Words released on Steam today![/h3]
We're super excited to get it out for players and are looking forward to hearing what you want next! It's on sale for the Early Access release right now, and there's also an added discount if you get the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26930/Party_Pack/]Deck Packs as a bundle[/url]! [i]Please leave us a review[/i] if you pick it up!! It honestly helps us a ton when you review our games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26930/Party_Pack/
[h3]Stuff to Know![/h3]
[list]
[*] Party Words is intended for in-person parties.
[*] There is no TV or "group screen" required, so it can be played on the go.
[*] The game can be played 2 ways: everyone has their own device connected online, or everyone plays using a single device that is passed around.
[*] Your screen should be hidden from other players during play!!!!!!!!!!!!
[/list]

[h3]We've added Doodle Mode![/h3]
[previewyoutube=u7tw94fGV7s;full][/previewyoutube]
We just got this in, like yesterday, Pass and Play is Coming Soon! To play, click "Host a Game", and then have your friends join the game with the room code. Pro Tip: This works for all the other game modes too ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/fbbab1af3f5e760adf0a5fd676a8c9b572abb5e6.png[/img]

If you have non-Steam friends who want to join, the game is available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.kelsam.partywords]Google Play[/url]! If you already have Party Words installed on Google Play, you may need to [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.kelsam.partywords]update it[/url] to access the new modes.

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.kelsam.partywords][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/e3d04154eb3bd3788eb66e084e289f5773ebd43d.png[/img][/url]

[h3]If You Have Any Feedback....[/h3]
Did you find a bug or worse, a spelling error? What type of game modes, options, and decks would you like to see next? We also accept rude comments, love notes, and cries for help.
[list]
[*]You can send feedback to us from the in-game option (Settings > Contact).
[*]Directly from our [url=https://partywords.kelsam.net/#contact]website[/url].
[*]Or through the discussion boards here on Steam.
[/list]
[b]We love to hear from you![/b] But in the genuine [i]there are two of us here and we get excited and read and talk about each of your messages[/i] way, not in the [i]please direct your feedback to either marketing or customer support[/i] way.

[h3]Subscribe to Updates:[/h3]
We send out email updates to our website subscribers! If you'd like to be added to the list  so you can be the first to know about new stuff, you can sign up [url=https://kelsam.net/subscribe/?subscription=5]here[/url]. We also make some [url=https://kelsam.net/]other cool games and tabletop stuff[/url] that you can check out while you're on the site.

Let's Get This Party Started!
- Kelsam
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Kelsam][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42380436/9773d37b7afb94f06cacd5ceeb86ab55812ae91e.png[/img][/url]
